ops.title: cc-pane: agent actions (attach, kill, message)
ops.description: Deferred from the cc-pane v1 plan (v1 is read-only by user decision). Add write actions to the agent view: attach to the agent's terminal, kill, and send-message via the corresponding cco procedures. Needs confirm-style UX in the TUI and careful key routing alongside the read-only bindings.
